from fluentqt.spatial import SpatialView
from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF, Qt
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtGui import QVector3D
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
control = SpatialView(%PARENT%)
card = fluentqt.Card()
card.setFixedSize(240, 136)
card.setAppearance(fluentqt.Card.Appearance.LayerAlt)
layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
layout.addWidget(fluentqt.Label("Perspective", card))
layout.addWidget(fluentqt.Label("Adjust the camera and zoom.", card))
layout.addWidget(fluentqt.Button("Inspect layer", card), 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
item = control.addOwnedWidget(card)
item.setPosition(QVector3D(0, 0, 60))
item.setRotation(QVector3D(8, -18, 0))
